operation: Original Kiwami 2 WPC three-hit chain, heavy attack, floor attack, ready/relaxed holds and original wlk_ftl_wpc walking arms. Six walking composites retain native normal/slow/injured leg, torso and deferred travel channels, source arm directions phase-mapped to each native cycle. All source frames retained at 30 fps and base speed 1. The first original BEP collision frame drives the existing one-damage-event PZ swing; all authored hitbox starts are recorded and quickstep cancellation waits for the last one. Native combo release policy and damage balance retained. Holds fit original source arm directions onto unchanged native idle body/legs. The supplied bicycle mesh is fitted to native skinned palm centres using model-surface frame grips. No new models, pixels, sound or source body poses.
